scopes.name: First Contract (Tutorial Job)
scopes.description: Introductory freelance contract introducing app audio narration, time-pressured worker placement, and gig scoring.

scopes.name: The Big Score Campaign
scopes.description: Standard narrative campaign featuring five distinct high-stakes freelance jobs through post-apocalyptic fantasy ruins.

scopes.name: All Contracts & Expansion Jobs
scopes.description: Complete run playing all included story scenarios with varied character builds and legacy character sheets.

milestones.title: The First Payday
milestones.description: Complete your crew's first contract, level up quirky skills, and record titles on your character sheet.

milestones.title: Wasteland Notoriety
milestones.description: Survive bizarre mutant encounters and build the party's infamous reputation among rival guilds.

milestones.title: Crossroads Dilemma
milestones.description: Face difficult moral decisions triggered by Crossroads cards that pit personal greed against party survival.

milestones.title: The Grand Score
milestones.description: Infiltrate a perilous corporate ruin to secure the ultimate treasure trove before the timer expires.

milestones.title: Hall of Legends
milestones.description: Calculate lifetime plunder, cement your freelancer titles in folklore, and retire in outrageous luxury.
